schema.title: Version Registry Entry
schema.description: Data contract of a sys-version-registry instance. The instance key is the component key (for a Flow, the bare flow key). defaultVersion is the default-version pointer; null clears it.

type.description: Kind of component the entry governs. Informational; not read by version resolution.

defaultVersion.description: Default-version pointer: major (2), minor (2.1), artifact (2.1.0), full (2.1.0-pkg.1.0.0) or null to clear.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason for the change.
